column1: # Law map for the Rust port. Everything not listed resolves to its seed. See scripts/gpui/law-map.py.
# Bend stream: laws stated by native/host tests (backplane-hub). The Bend code stays; these claim the Rust twin.

# files stream (M6): native/host/src/files/fm.rs, the Rust twin of core/fm.bend's pure rules until the rules process is wired. The Bend defs stay; the corpus test/gpui/files/hostile_paths.tsv is the golden input for diffing them.
# files stream: native/host/src/kicad/plot.rs (the hub side of core/plot.bend; the parser stays the Bend child)

# files stream: native/host/src/kicad/kserve.rs (Rust twin of core/kserve.bend's pure rules until the rules process is wired; the Bend defs stay). Not mapped: kserve_desc_needs_cap, kserve_desc_with_cap, kserve_idle_needs_api2 (universally quantified; the Rust test only samples them).
# native/host/src/shelf.rs: the settle rule, snooze and shelf split (tests carry the laws' names)
# thread-folder boundary (#960): the Rust hub refuses unresolved thread folders (native/host/src/files/threadpath.rs)

# files stream (M6) plots: native/host/src/kicad/{plotgen,plotread,board,schematic}.rs, the Rust twins of core/plot, hist, hier, board, pcb2d, look. Bend stays the reference; test/gpui/files/plot_*.py compare them byte for byte.
# native/host/src/signal.rs and sidebar.rs: the thread signal and what the sidebar lists (tests carry the laws' names)
# files stream: 3D models and renders in Rust (kicad/glb.rs, png.rs, mesh.rs, solid.rs, render.rs)

# files stream: design review twins (kicad/{bom,checks,cad,release,review,kexport}.rs). The rules stay Bend in the final design; these state the same claims. A law over all values (checks_execution_keeps_identity, kexport_no_*) is tested on a corpus.
